tasks.title: Google Search
tasks.description: Search Google and return ranked page titles, URLs, snippets and positions as JSON. CLI and MCP via FlashData.

tasks.title: Google News
tasks.description: Search Google News and return headlines, publishers, date labels and article links as JSON. CLI and MCP via FlashData.

tasks.title: Google Images
tasks.description: Search Google Images and return image URLs, dimensions and source-page links as JSON. CLI and MCP via FlashData.

tasks.title: Google Shopping
tasks.description: Search Google Shopping and return product offers, merchants and displayed prices as JSON. CLI and MCP via FlashData.

tasks.title: Google Video Search
tasks.description: Search Google Videos across websites and return video titles, links, sources and available durations as JSON. CLI and MCP via FlashData.

tasks.title: Google Places
tasks.description: Find local businesses and places with addresses, ratings and available review counts as JSON. CLI and MCP via FlashData.

tasks.title: YouTube Search
tasks.description: Search YouTube with keyword, date, duration and sorting filters. Request up to 20 video results. CLI and MCP via FlashData.

tasks.title: YouTube Extended Search
tasks.description: Search YouTube with filters and up to 700 requested results, returned as structured video records. CLI and MCP via FlashData.

tasks.title: YouTube Metadata
tasks.description: Get YouTube video details, descriptions, statistics and available chapters or formats as JSON. CLI and MCP via FlashData.

tasks.title: YouTube Transcript
tasks.description: Get existing YouTube transcripts with timed segments. Selects automatic captions by default. CLI and MCP via FlashData.

tasks.title: YouTube Captions
tasks.description: Get existing YouTube captions with timed segments. Selects uploader-provided captions by default. CLI and MCP via FlashData.

tasks.title: YouTube Creative Commons License Metadata
tasks.description: Read a YouTube video’s Creative Commons license-label metadata as JSON. CLI and MCP via FlashData.

tasks.title: YouTube Channel Data
tasks.description: Get a YouTube channel profile and recent videos by handle, with up to 100 requested videos. CLI and MCP via FlashData.

tasks.title: YouTube Autocomplete
tasks.description: Get YouTube autocomplete phrases for a search prefix, language and region. CLI and MCP via FlashData.

tasks.title: YouTube Download to Cloud Storage
tasks.description: Download YouTube video, audio or clips to your own S3 or other supported cloud storage. CLI and MCP via FlashData.
